outcome: Give hotel gm / hospitality revenue director a governed method to improve off-contract procurement percentage using supplier contracts, unit prices and site purchases, with final decisions retained…
overview: Hotel Group Procurement Contract Compliance addresses source evidence is scattered across documents and transaction systems, leading to repeated checks and incomplete case files in hospitality and tourism operations. The first proof of value uses supplier contracts, unit prices and site purchases. It produces a reviewed operational recommendation and a traceable decision record. The commercial success measure is off-contract procurement percentage, established from customer baseline data before any improvement is claimed.

scope:
Delivery model: Redington or approved implementation partner, eligibility and staffing pending confirmation.
Duration: Discovery and design first; pilot and rollout durations depend on data access and scope; no fixed commitment.
1) Discover source quality and baseline: supplier contracts, unit prices and site purchases; define off-contract procurement percentage and data-processing boundary.
2) Design control points, security and connector contracts; obtain owner approval from Hotel GM / Hospitality Revenue Director.
3) Implement one bounded workflow, instrument missing-data exceptions and system-of-record write-back.
4) Test positive, negative, privilege, partial-data and rollback cases including run golden documents and exceptions against the system of record.
5) Review KPI in the pilot, document evidence, perform training and agree transition.
deliverables: Agreed test threshold for off-contract procurement percentage
